title: Prove a baseline from green CI

rubric.text: Cites the trusted green required CI run on B7 as baseline evidence and does not run a local full build or suite for that purpose.
Still proves the proposed seam with a focused local check such as running or inspecting `ReportFormatterTest`.
Records the CI run and focused check in the plan's evidence.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
